confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on two searches. I did not search for cocktails separately. The Numbeo-derived figures (via Expatica, June 2026) put an inexpensive meal at about €12.5, a mid-range meal for two at about €47, a cappuccino at about €2.2 and a 0.5L draught beer at about €3.1. Other sources gave slightly lower prices. I converted euros to USD at roughly 1.15, which is my own assumption. The wine glass and cocktail prices are estimated from the beer price, not from direct data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. July is hot and Córdoba is a tourist destination, but it is off-peak, so I assumed moderate rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Córdoba's own Numbeo-type price data. For accommodation I used comparable mid-sized Andalusian tourist cities such as Granada and Seville, adjusted slightly downward.
